quick_skim.title: Attribute-based Undetectable Watermarking for Generative AI Models
quick_skim.abstract: Generative AI systems increasingly produce content whose provenance is difficult to verify, motivating watermarking techniques for identifying model-generated outputs. Existing cryptographic watermarking methods provide strong undetectability guarantees: without a detection key, watermarked outputs are computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. However, these approaches do not address the crucial deployment challenge of how to safely delegate detection capabilities. With an unrestricted detection key, a malicious detector may use the detection key beyond its intended scope, enabling watermark sanitization, scope abuse, and user profiling.   To mitigate this safety concern, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first \emph{attribute-based watermarking} for generative AI models, providing fine-grained, policy-controlled watermark detection. In our approach, each generated output is associated with attributes, and each detection key is \emph{constrained by a policy} on potential attributes. A detection key can only be used to detect watermarked outputs whose attributes satisfy the corresponding policy, while watermarked outputs that fall outside the policy remain computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. We construct such an attribute-based watermarking scheme and formalize its security properties, including consistency, adaptive robustness to bounded corruptions, undetectability, and soundness, along with a security proof under standard cryptographic assumptions. Our construction integrates constrained pseudorandom functions, pseudorandom error-correcting codes, and randomness recovery procedures with generative AI models. Finally, we implement a prototype and an empirical evaluation, demonstrating that attribute-based watermarking is both effective and practical.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对生成式AI模型输出内容难以验证来源且现有加密水印方法的检测密钥存在滥用风险（如水印清除、范围滥用和用户画像），本文提出首个基于属性的不可检测水印，利用基于属性的加密原语将检测能力与属性绑定，仅当检测方属性满足预设策略时才能正确提取水印，否则输出与未加水印内容计算不可区分，从而在保障不可检测性的同时实现安全的委托检测；实验验证了该方案在保持高质量生成的同时有效防止检测密钥滥用，为负责任地部署生成式AI水印提供了新范式。

quick_skim.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
quick_skim.abstract: Although semantic watermarking is considered a promising safeguard for images generated by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), the reliance of the watermark detection pipeline on neural networks introduces a critical yet underexplored backdoor attack surface. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose GhostVAE to plant a stealthy backdoor into the encoder of Variational Autoencoder (VAE), enabling reliable evasion of watermark detection. GhostVAE operates in two stages: it first constructs a universal trigger via power spectrum regularization to improve the trigger robustness, and then trains a backdoored VAE encoder with a parameter-aligned objective. Through extensive evaluations across three state-of-the-art semantic watermarking schemes and three widely adopted LDMs, we show that GhostVAE preserves watermark detection performance on benign images (achieving an average true positive rate of 94.4%), while simultaneously enabling highly effective evasion under trigger activation (achieving an average attack success rate of 94.6%). Moreover, we comprehensively analyze seventeen representative defenses and demonstrate that GhostVAE remains stealthy across the input space, parameter space, and latent space. Our work fundamentally undermines the trustworthiness of semantic watermarking systems and highlights that secure deployment of semantic watermarks requires end-to-end security considerations, particularly for neural network components.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes GhostVAE, a stealthy backdoor attack against semantic watermarking for diffusion model outputs, by training a triggered VAE encoder via power spectrum regularization and parameter-aligned objectives, exposing a critical vulnerability in neural-network-based detection of AI-generated images.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对潜在扩散模型输出图像的语义水印保护，本文研究其检测管道依赖神经网络的后门攻击面，提出GhostVAE，通过功率谱正则化构造通用触发器，并训练参数对齐的后门VAE编码器，可靠地逃避水印检测。在三种前沿水印方案上的评估验证了攻击有效性，揭示了AI生成图像检测中存在的关键安全漏洞，呼吁加强防御研究。
